name: Vincent Knight
source:
Likes: Something tasty
Dislikes: Sweets
Hobby: Training
Skill: Other than healing magic and cooking

"I have to protect the woman I love even if it kills me."

Joel: Vincent came to the academy as a visiting student.
He is quite talented in offensive magic, thus he teaches classes in this nature.
I heard, his knowledge for magic excels all the professors in the academy.
His profession is a magic researcher, he says, however...
Nobody knows the truth of his background.
Well, I have never seen such a musicalized stern looking researcher before though...
Some students inquired about his origin but, it seems he does not feel pleasant to talk about it.

[Official in-game description]
